title: Suggestions to review before anything is implemented
policy: Nothing on this page has been implemented. Each row names the decision it asks for and what it would cost. The verdict column is blank on purpose - it is the owner's.

rows.title: Buy or license one price source and store it hashed, before any ROI number is ever published
rows.why: Four of the six open requirements depend on it, and an assumed price has already produced a non-achievable +28.5% in a peer namespace.
rows.asks: A decision between a licensed feed, a personal-use archive, and no prices at all.
rows.cost: Licence fee, or permanent acceptance that ROI stays blank.

rows.title: Make game books the participation source and parse all 14 Week-10 fixtures
rows.why: Starters, actives and participation are the one official record that answers 'who actually played'. One fixture is parsed today.
rows.asks: Approve the parsing cost. It is mechanical once the PDF route is fixed.
rows.cost: Roughly one parsing pass per fixture, then it runs unattended.

rows.title: Adopt the dated reserve list as a required input to every availability view
rows.why: Without it, a player on IR looks healthy because he is absent from the injury report. Two such cases are already visible.
rows.asks: Approve adding it to the daily capture.

rows.title: Publish the Week-11 lines as a dated forecast and score them in public after the games
rows.why: A forecast that is not recorded before kickoff cannot be scored honestly afterwards. The 13 rows exist; recording them costs nothing.
rows.asks: Confirm the pre-registration and the scoring rule are the ones you want.

rows.title: Keep ROI off the leaderboard until stage 2 can be scored
rows.why: Every ROI in this repository, in every namespace, is either blank or built on an assumed price. Ranking on it would reward the assumption.
rows.asks: Confirm that a blank stage-2 column is acceptable for now.
rows.cost: The leaderboard looks emptier. That is the honest state.

rows.title: Consolidate the duplicate results feeds into one owner
rows.why: Two feeds agree today. They are edited by different sessions and will not necessarily agree next week.

rows.title: Move to per-session coordination files
rows.why: Every concurrent merge in this session conflicted in the one shared append-only file. Resolution works but costs a human read each time.
rows.asks: Approve a change to the coordination convention.

rows.title: Treat 'Questionable' as unknown until the play rate is measured, and say so in the UI
rows.why: The league publishes the word without a probability. A UI that colours it red implies a meaning nobody has measured here.
rows.asks: Confirm that a blank is preferable to a plausible-looking number.

rows.title: Add a second independent model and publish both totals until one wins
rows.why: The brief asks for this. One estimator cannot be compared with itself, and two estimators turn a claim into a test.

rows.title: Record every published number with the exact page and read date in a machine-readable ledger
rows.why: The strongest claim this repository can make is that every number can be traced. It is currently true per page, not per number.
